# Feature Matrix

TokenPak's OSS beta is Apache 2.0. Pro-only, roadmap, and unsupported surfaces are marked per capability; an item is not part of the current OSS beta unless the OSS column says Shipped or Preview.

Current OSS beta floor: v1.11.1.

## Availability labels

| Label | Meaning |
|---|---|
| Shipped | Available in the OSS beta. |
| Preview | Available, but still beta-quality or intentionally narrow. |
| Documented pattern | Documented guidance or recipe, not a blanket product guarantee. |
| Pro only | Requires the TokenPak Pro distribution or daemon. |
| Roadmap | Planned or under design; not in the current OSS beta. |
| Unsupported | Not a shipped TokenPak surface. |

## Core proxy

| Capability | OSS beta | Pro | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| Local proxy passthrough | Shipped | Not required | Runs locally on 127.0.0.1 and forwards requests to the configured model provider. |
| Provider routing | Preview | Optional extensions | Use the documented provider and client guides. Broad any-provider claims are out of scope for the beta. |
| Provider fallback recipes | Documented pattern | Optional extensions | Recipes describe fallback patterns; the OSS beta does not guarantee automatic failover for every request. |
| Circuit and spend safeguards | Shipped | Optional extensions | Spend Guard blocks configured runaway requests before they reach the provider. |

## Compression and savings

| Capability | OSS beta | Pro | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| Prompt Packing pipeline | Shipped | Not required | Deterministic context reduction for eligible workloads. Savings depend on workload, provider pricing, and cache eligibility. |
| Compression profiles | Shipped | Not required | Built-in profiles are configurable; measure your own workload with the local savings tools. |
| Savings ledger and attribution | Shipped | Optional extensions | Local usage records distinguish TokenPak effects from provider/client cache effects. |
| Fixture demo | Shipped | Not required | The demo is an offline smoke test, not proof of live customer savings. |

## Observability

| Capability | OSS beta | Pro | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| Local dashboard | Preview | Optional extensions | Reads local telemetry and request records; hosted/cloud dashboards are not part of the OSS beta. |
| CLI status and savings reports | Shipped | Optional extensions | Use status and savings commands for local attribution and troubleshooting. |
| Built-in Prometheus exporter | Unsupported | Not promised | Use a custom exporter over local records if you need Prometheus-style metrics. |

## Integrations

| Capability | OSS beta | Pro | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| Client setup guides | Shipped | Not required | Guides cover the documented beta clients; each client still sends requests to its configured model provider. |
| TIP-1.0 protocol contracts | Preview | Optional extensions | Headers, manifests, and conformance references are public beta surfaces. |

## Vault and recall

| Capability | OSS beta | Pro | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| Vault indexing and search | Preview | Optional extensions | Local indexing and search are available; behavior is bounded by the documented beta limitations. |
| Pak inspect and recall data plane | Preview | Optional extensions | OSS exposes read-only Pak inspection and recall data. Scoring and assembly are separate Pro surfaces. |
| Pak scoring, capture, and Context Package assembly | Not included | Pro only | Requires the Pro daemon or private Pro distribution. |

## Commercial and roadmap

| Capability | OSS beta | Pro | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| TokenPak Pro license and daemon workflows | Not included | Pro only | Private Pro workflows are not part of the Apache 2.0 OSS beta. |
| Dispatch Center | Roadmap | Roadmap | Dispatch documentation is being scoped separately; it should not be described as per-request routing. |
| Vision and multimodal workflows | Roadmap | Roadmap | Not part of the current OSS beta. |

## Boundary notes

- Requests still go to the model provider you configure; TokenPak does not run a hosted model service for the OSS beta.
- Savings depend on workload, provider pricing, and cache eligibility. Use local status and savings commands for attribution.
- Pro-only rows are not part of the Apache 2.0 OSS beta surface.
